info.name: Integriq — chain E integration tests
info.description:
Post-OR-cutover (chain B/C) integration suite.

Design:
1. **OR-backed fixture setup** (folder 01) — creates source/mapping/endpoint/job/synchronization/consumer/rule/event/eventSubscription via OR's `/api/objects/integriq/{schema}/*`. UUIDs cached in collection variables for downstream use.
2. **Surviving integriq action endpoints** (folders 02–12) — exercises every named route in `appinfo/routes.php`. Fixtures from step 1 supply IDs.
3. **End-to-end user journeys** (folder 13) — Source→Mapping→Object, Source→Synchronization→Run→Contract, Endpoint gateway round-trip, Event pub/sub. Each journey owns its own fixtures and cleans up.
4. **Teardown** (folder 99) — deletes shared fixtures via OR.

The suite is hermetic: it expects a freshly-seeded dev container, makes no assumption about pre-existing data, and leaves the database in the state it found it.

Environment vars: `baseUrl`, `admin_user`, `admin_pass`. Run via `npm run test:newman`.

Route audit (sync with `appinfo/routes.php`):
- Resource block removed in this cutover — CRUD now at `/api/objects/integriq/{schema}/*`.
- 67 named routes still active. Every one of them is touched by this suite.

item.name: GET /api/registers — integriq register references its entity schemas

exec: // The register referenced exactly 15 schemas when this smoke test was written — the 15 chain-C entities.
// It now references 53: lib/Settings/register.d/ has grown to 40 fragments that add Peppol Transmission,
// Payment Intent, Bankfeed Connection/Batch, Cardfeed Account/Batch, LTI 1.3, KISS Klantcontact, iWMO/iJW,
// FSC Service/Call and 4 log schemas — all listed in the register's own description. An installed instance
// gets the same merged set, so 15 is a stale snapshot, not a defect. An exact count is the wrong invariant
// here: it re-breaks on every new sub-domain while never checking that the RIGHT schemas are referenced.
// The core entity schemas are covered by identity elsewhere — folder 01 creates an object in each of

item.name: 18 — Product channels (events-async-api-products)
item.description: openspec/changes/events-async-api-products (REQ-AAPI-002, REQ-AAPI-003, REQ-AAPI-004). Hermetic: seeds its own product (one channel, a tier of 2 requests per 60 s), a JWT consumer and a product subscription, and deletes them at the end. The tier budget is shared by the channel routes: the pull and the refused subscribe spend it, the next pull is 429. That endpoints and channels share the one counter is pinned by PHPUnit on ProductPolicyService.
